# Graduate Corporate Finance Analyst (ACA) 2027

Deadline: 11th Jan 2027 

Financial Consulting

 Graduate job 

 London 

 MHA MacIntyre Hudson Financial Services 

MHA MacIntyre Hudson

Quick overview Show Hide

### What it is

- You’ll help businesses make big deal decisions, like buying/selling companies or raising investment.
- You’ll analyse financial and market information and help write client reports and presentations.
- You’ll train on a graduate scheme in a corporate finance team at an accountancy firm.

### Who it's for

- Achieved or predicted 2:1 degree (or above).
- At least 112 UCAS points from your top three subjects (or equivalent).

### Good to know

- Includes full study support while you work towards the ACA Level 7 qualification.

This overview was generated using AI

We’re looking for talented individuals who bring initiative, creativity, and curiosity to the table. In return, you’ll gain valuable hands-on experience, receive mentorship from some of the industry’s best and earn recognised professional qualification.

By the end of your Graduate Programme, you’ll be a well-rounded, commercially minded professional, ready to take on interesting and challenging responsibilities. You won’t just be fully qualified - you’ll be fully prepared to drive your own career forward.

## What sets us apart

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. In 2026, we ranked as number 11 in the UK’s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world’s 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.

Our people-centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose-led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves.

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.

## Here, you’ll go beyond numbers

We are looking for a Corporate Finance Analyst to join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes.

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Corporate Finance will go beyond the numbers, we believe in hands-on learning. You’ll be doing real work on real projects, not just shadowing.

While you’ll receive mentorship and guidance, we prefer you to learn through extensive and practical on-the-job training.

Corporate Finance is a varied and commercially focused career where you’ll help businesses make some of their most important decisions. You could support clients looking to buy or sell a business, raise finance, secure investment or plan the next stage of their growth. No two projects are the same, giving you the opportunity to work with a wide range of organisations, industries and people.

From an early stage, you’ll build relationships with clients and work closely with experienced colleagues across MHA. You’ll ask questions, gather financial and commercial information, research businesses and markets, and contribute to reports and presentations for clients. You’ll also develop your analytical skills and commercial awareness, helping you understand what drives a successful business and identify the information that matters.

You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. We’re looking for people who are curious, willing to learn and comfortable working collaboratively. If you enjoy understanding how businesses work and grow, analysing information, solving problems and working with different people on a variety of projects, Corporate Finance could be a great fit for you.

As a Corporate Finance Analyst, you’ll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams on real projects, build lasting connections with colleagues and start off by learning the fundamentals, including:

- Analysing financial information
- Assisting with the development and drafting of reports and business planning documentation
- Conducting detailed market research and analysis
- Attending client meetings and developing relationships
- Assisting with the efficient project management of transaction processes
- Studying towards Professional Qualification (ACA Level 7)

## Rewards that resonate

You’re more than a number to us; you’re someone with unique skills and aspirations. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, foster your professional growth, and recognise the contribution you make.

- Agile working: Our flexible working policy gives you greater choice over how you structure your day. With core hours of 10am–2pm, you can start earlier or finish later to suit your needs, alongside the option to work from home up to two days a week. For trainees, we ask for full office attendance during the first six months to ensure you receive the training, support and experience needed for a strong start, with greater flexibility available after that.
- 30 days’ holiday, including bank holidays, plus the opportunity to buy or sell up to 5 days (28 days on a training contract, with the opportunity to buy 5 days).
- Full study support package: including exams, tuition, study leave days and materials.
- Employee recognition awards: Performance Award bonus and other recognition initiatives.
- Employee Assistance Programme: A free, confidential 24-hour support service, including unlimited counselling sessions and access to virtual doctors for you and your family.
- And lots more!

## Disability Confident

We are a Disability Confident employer. If you have a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role, we will progress you to the next stage of the process.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process to help you perform at your best, please let us know and we will be happy to help.

description:
Finance Analyst (EMEA) 2026 - Jimmy Choo | Bright Network

# Finance Analyst (EMEA) 2026

Rolling deadline

Accounting, Audit & Tax

 Graduate job 

 London 

Quick overview Show Hide

### What it is

- You'll support the EMEA commercial finance team with forecasts, budgets and weekly KPI reporting.
- You'll help run month-end close, including reconciliations, accruals, intercompany recharges and SOX controls.
- You'll provide insights for trading decisions, from cost-saving ideas to capex and depreciation planning.

### Who it's for

- A graduate from a top tier university aiming to undertake the CIMA qualification.
- Strong Excel and wider Microsoft Office skills.

This overview was generated using AI

This role will work closely with the Senior Finance Analyst, EMEA to deliver on all aspects of financial planning and analysis, with key focus on KPI reporting to provide decision support. The role will also play a key role in the monthly close process.

## Key responsibilities and duties

- Support the Commercial Finance team, EMEA in the preparation of EMEA forecast financial information and the budget cycle, including retail and wholesale operations within the region.
- Provide key financial and commercial insights to support discussions on the weekly EMEA trade call.
- Take ownership of delegated budget and forecast processes including the setup of key reports and calendars.
- Monitor capital expenditure against budget, and take the lead on depreciation forecasting and budgeting.
- Prepare accurate weekly KPI reporting, delivered in a timely manner.
- Work together with the Senior Finance Analyst, EMEA to identify cost saving opportunities in the region.
- Review month end reconciliations, including monitoring aged creditors, ensuring SOX compliance throughout month end processes.
- Prepare month end accruals and intercompany recharges.
- Prepare monthly commissions calculations.
- Participate in commercial decision making, challenging and advising on assumptions and conclusions so that the business can make the right financial calls.
- Review the bi-weekly payment run for Czech Republic.
- Assist with preparation of ad hoc financial information as required.
- Use own initiative to identify value add projects where time permits.
- Provide admin support within the EMEA finance team as and when required.

## Skills, experience and qualifications

- Graduate from a top tier university with the goal of undertaking the CIMA qualification.
- Strong interest in retail.
- Strong skills in all Microsoft applications including but not limited to Excel, Word, Outlook, Powerpoint.
- Drive for Results: Communicates persuasively to win support, minimises or removes barriers that get in the way of achieving results and leverages understanding of key business drivers to deliver results.
- Decision Making: Makes the right short-term decisions without sacrificing long-term results. Balances competing priorities without losing momentum behind execution. The individual should translate strategies into plans that can be effectively executed and transform data and information into meaningful insights.
- Collaborates and Influences: Collaborates well with others and is able to influence at a senior level in the organisation through reasoning and relationships. Understands and uses informal networks at the appropriate level to achieve desired results.
- Builds Talent: Encourages and coaches people to build their skills; gives constructive, actionable feedback to help people improve their performance. Shares knowledge and skills with others to build broader capability.

## Characteristics required

- Commercial acumen.
- Analytical, strategic, detail-conscious.
- Approachable, calm and a collaborative team player.
- Able to act as an ambassador for the Jimmy Choo brand internally and externally.
- The ability to work well under pressure and to deadlines.
- The ability to problem solve.
- Excellent time-management and organizational skills.
- A confident, determined and ‘can do’ personality with a passion for work.
- Willingness to take ownership and see tasks through end to end.

title: 2027 Wealth Management (Transformation) Graduate Programme
description:
Job title: Wealth Transformation Graduate Department: Wealth Transformation, Wealth Management Salary: £45,000 Start date: Thursday 16 September 2027 Location: City of London, London

About Schroders, our parent company

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Programme overview:
Our two-year Wealth Transformation Graduate Programme offers a unique opportunity to gain broad experience across Business Transformation at one of the UKs leading & fastest growing wealth management business. You’ll combine on-the-job experience with structured learning and development, including taking the Investment Advisory Diploma (IAD), and opportunities to network with colleagues across the business.

As part of the programme, you will undertake rotations within Wealth Transformation, gaining hands-on experience in the roles of Business Architecture, Strategic design, Business Analysis and Project Management

Through these rotations, you will gain exposure to strategic design opportunities spanning the Wealth business, including Client teams, Investment, Operations and key support functions.

Who we are looking for

• A strong interest in the transformation of a business to improve growth, efficiency and risk outcomes

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to express ideas clearly and work effectively with a range of colleagues.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented, building trusted connections within teams and across the organisation.

• Inquisitive and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in Wealth Management and relevant industry trends.

• Innovative, analytical and able to apply critical thinking by thinking ‘outside the box’ and applying a fresh perspective, particularly using AI.

• Proactive, organised, and eager to get involved in a broad range of tasks, projects, and teams.

• Adaptable and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities, remain composed during periods of uncertainty, and embrace new challenges.

• A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, a high attention to detail who takes the initiative and delivers high-quality work.

• A growth mindset - we understand you may make mistakes, and when you do, we are looking for you to learn from these.

• Eager to learn and develop, actively embracing feedback, pursuing professional growth, and demonstrating natural curiosity.

• Problem solver with the ability to ‘get into the detail’ whilst seeing and managing the ‘bigger picture’.

The Team

Schroders Wealth Transformation team has a remit across the transformation lifecycle from strategy to execution. We collaborate with our business and technology partners across the Schroders Group to enable our Cazenove Capital and Schroders International Wealth business to thrive in an increasingly competitive, regulated and margin pressured global landscape by shaping, mobilising and delivering both transformational and essential change to allow the business to grow profitably while providing high levels of investment performance and client experience.

What you will do

Throughout the programme, you will take an active role in a broad range of transformation projects and initiatives. You will gain exposure to and experience in the key Change roles of Business Architect, Project Manager and Business Analyst, with hands-on experience within each discipline. You will have the opportunity to contribute at all stages of the Change lifecycle, from strategy and design, to project delivery and implementation.

•
Project Management: Collaborate with project teams and business stakeholders to drive the successful delivery of change initiatives on time and within budget. Establish a critical path and deliverable plan, ensuring clarity of direction, effective communication, and disciplined project governance throughout each phase.

•
Business Analysis: Act as a bridge between business needs and solutions, working collaboratively with stakeholders to understand and articulate requirements, define target processes, and support the design and realisation of effective, value-driven change.

•
Business Architect : Contributing as a proactive team member, building knowledge of the business, strategic design, and operating model, to support the design and delivery of successful transformation projects to help solve business challenges and create sustainable value for the organisation.

Qualifications required:

• An honours degree or equivalent – we are open to all degree subjects and predicted grades

• You will be in your final year of study or have already graduated

No prior Change or Wealth Management experience is need. We just need you to bring your drive, passion and enthusiasm to make the most of the opportunity, to start building your career.
Benefits of joining us :

When you join the Wealth Transformation Graduate programme at Schroders, you will benefit from a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities, including:

• Professional qualifications: Achieve the Investment Advice Diploma (IAD) in your first few weeks - the UK’s benchmark entry qualification for investment professionals Opportunity to complete further qualifications related to your role

• Comprehensive training: Access immersive training sessions covering industry knowledge, technical skills, and essential soft skills to help you adapt, thrive, and make an impact from day one

• Senior networking opportunities: Attend exclusive “Coffee Hours” hosted by senior leaders, allowing you to build your network within the industry

• Buddy system: Be paired with a dedicated buddy to support your transition into both the programme and the wider business

• Wellbeing support: Access to our Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24-hour confidential counselling and resources on a range of topics, including mental health Use of a private GP service

• On-site facilities: Enjoy the convenience of an on-site staff restaurant and complimentary use of our on-site gym

By joining us, you will be part of an inclusive environment where your learning, wellbeing, and professional growth are a priority.
Recruitment process:

• Online application form

• Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment

• Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment

• Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview

• Assessment centre

Candidates should be available to start the Wealth Transformation Graduate programme on Thursday 16 September 2027.

We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

title: Graduate - Digital Trading (m/f/d)
description:
What's Your Possible?

Take on a role where your ideas, analytical thinking and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future.

As a Digital Trading Graduate, you'll rotate across teams involved in systematic and algorithmic trading, gaining hands-on experience of how technology, data and operational controls support trading activity across fast-moving energy markets. You'll develop an understanding of trading processes, data quality, technology platforms and regulatory controls while contributing to initiatives that improve performance and efficiency.

This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy working with technology, analysing data and solving complex problems. You'll gain broad exposure to both commercial and technical aspects of energy trading while developing specialist knowledge that can lead to future careers in Digital Trading, Trading Technology or related disciplines.

What Will You Do?

• Rotate across Trading, Development and IT teams to understand how technology, data and operational processes combine to support successful trading activities.

• Perform quality assurance activities on data, processes and controls, identifying exceptions and ensuring issues are escalated appropriately.

• Analyse datasets and operational information to identify trends, inconsistencies and opportunities for process improvement.

• Maintain accurate documentation, audit trails and records relating to analysis, controls, process changes and operational activities.

• Investigate and help resolve issues relating to digital and algorithmic trading systems and tools.

• Contribute to projects that improve the efficiency, reliability and effectiveness of Digital Trading processes and controls.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Trading, Quantitative Research, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams to better understand business requirements and market operations.

• Gain exposure to regulatory controls and governance requirements that support responsible trading activities.

• Take ownership of your learning and development, applying new skills and knowledge throughout the graduate programme.

What Will You Bring?

We're looking for curious, analytical and technically-minded graduates who enjoy understanding how technology can be used to solve business challenges. You'll have a natural interest in data, systems and financial or energy markets, alongside a willingness to learn and develop in a fast-moving commercial environment.

You'll ideally have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree, completed or due to be completed before the programme starts, in Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative discipline.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, interpret data and draw logical conclusions.

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow defined processes while maintaining accurate records and documentation.

• Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and other tools used to analyse, manipulate and present data.

• An interest in developing technical skills in areas such as SQL, Python, software development, data engineering or data visualisation. Previous coding experience would be beneficial but is not essential.

• Strong communication skills, with the confidence to explain findings, issues and recommendations clearly to different audiences.

• Good judgement and a responsible approach to controls, governance and risk management.

• The ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across Trading, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Data teams.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality work.

• A genuine interest in energy markets, digital innovation and the role of technology in improving trading performance and decision-making.

• Curiosity, adaptability and a strong desire to continuously learn and develop new skills throughout your career.

Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted.

About Us

SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany.

Securing energy – now and for the future.

Our Benefits

In return we offer a competitive salary supported by a comprehensive range of financial, lifestyle and wellness benefits with the flexibility to follow a hybrid working model.

• Bonus earning potential

• Non-contributory pension with 10% employer contribution

• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days

• Buy / sell holidays

• Life assurance

• Medical and dental insurance (family cover)

• Range of optional flexible benefits

We are committed to supporting your career growth with opportunities to develop both your knowledge and experience through a blended approach to learning.

Join SEFE and help us secure energy supply across Europe and shape a better, more sustainable tomorrow.

Built for specialist sectors, multi-jurisdiction structures, and high-compliance environments, we support businesses whose needs go beyond standard banking. We’re selective about who we work with because exceptional service requires focus and commitment.

With six international offices, six regulatory licences, and an 83% CAGR over the past three years, we’re scaling rapidly and earning industry recognition along the way — including the Financial Times FT1000: Europe’s Fastest Growing Companies 2026, CNBC UK’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, Wealth & Finance FinTech Awards 2026, and the Business Growth Award from Business Awards UK.

Behind it all is a team of ambitious VFXers united by collective ownership, a focus on growth, and a shared passion for solving complex problems.

About the Role

The Middle Office Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the integrity and efficiency of the FX post-trade process. This position is responsible for managing the full trade lifecycle, maintaining accurate reconciliations, and supporting margin and settlement activities. Acting as a key control point between Trading, Back Office, and Risk, the analyst monitors trading activity, resolves discrepancies, and escalates issues promptly to safeguard operational and financial risk. The role also contributes to process improvements and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

No prior work experience is necessary. This is a hands‑on role ideal for someone with a mathematics, finance, or other numerical‑related degree, strong analytical skills, and most importantly, a willingness to learn and develop.

Key Responsibilities

- Oversee the complete post-trade lifecycle of FX derivatives, from execution through to settlement, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
- Maintain robust trade capture, reconciliation, and control processes across multiple systems to safeguard data integrity.
- Monitor trading activity and operational flows, proactively identifying issues and escalating them to senior management when necessary.
- Collaborate effectively with Trading, Back Office, and Technology teams to resolve trade discrepancies and ensure seamless processing.
- Respond promptly to queries from Settlements and Payments teams, ensuring all transactions are reconciled daily and discrepancies are addressed without delay.
- Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of structured FX products, market risk, liquidity risk, and related operational considerations.
- Assist with process enhancements and automation initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
- Ensure comprehensive documentation and strict adherence to internal policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
- Manage trade reconciliation processes for both derivative and non‑derivative transactions, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
- Oversee margin call management for clients, including initial and variation margin, in line with contractual and regulatory obligations.
- Support the Financial Risk Manager in conducting credit facility reviews and monitoring counterparty exposures.

Additional responsibilities may be assigned by the Director of Trading, in line with the scope of the position, as reasonably required to support business and operational priorities.

Candidate Profile

Experience & Background

- Strong academic background in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or another numerate discipline (or equivalent experience)
- Understanding of derivatives and financial risk concepts; FX derivatives exposure desirable.

Technical Skills

- Strong numeracy and analytical capability.
- Proficiency in Excel; exposure to VBA or automation tools beneficial.
- Familiarity with trade support or trade capture systems advantageous

Core Competencies

- Attention to Detail: Maintains high accuracy across repetitive and time-sensitive tasks.
- Problem‑Solving: Identifies discrepancies and works proactively to resolve issues.
- Collaboration: Works seamlessly with Trading, Back Office, Settlements, Payments, Technology, and Risk teams to ensure smooth operations.
- Ownership: Takes responsibility for assigned processes, controls, and timely completion of tasks.
- Adaptability: Responds effectively to fluctuating workloads, evolving system requirements, and market‑driven operational demands.
- Communication: Provides clear, concise, and timely updates to internal stakeholders; escalates issues appropriately.
- Risk Awareness: Monitors trading activity and operational flows, proactively escalating potential risks to senior management.
- Regulatory & Policy Compliance: Ensures adherence to internal policies, procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements in all activities.

We offer more than just perks — we offer ownership.

Our benefits include:

- Generous Profit Share Plan (PSP)
- Potential equity opportunities via the Company Share Option Plan (CSOP)
- Hybrid working 3‑days per week at our Aldgate office
- Annual all-expenses paid company incentive trip abroad
- Flexible learning & development budget
- Weekly events like Supper Club, Thursday Happy Hour & regular socials
- Fresh fruit, breakfast staples & fully stocked drinks fridge in the office

If you care about building something meaningful, take pride in your work, and are motivated by impact — you’ll thrive here.
